study.question: After making direct target-match intensity explicit, is the complementary learned history signal supplied by trainable pooled values, query-independent learned event importance, or target-conditioned weighting? Can a simpler same-width summary preserve quality at lower measured cost? Observation: attention+matches g1-r0002-joint_count AUC .6171272214 exceeds count-only g1-r0003-count_summary .6130945529 by .0040326685 and attention+activity g1-r0003-attention_activity .6132432588 by .0038839626. The previous complete removal failed its quality objective; this discriminates which part should be retained.
study.hypothesis: Provisional mechanism: explicit bucket-match counts carry direct target relevance, while the remaining trainable history values carry generic category/brand/action/recency composition. Counts may therefore reduce the incremental need for a target-conditioned scorer, even though complete summary removal failed. Content-only weighting tests learned generic selection; uniform pooling additionally removes learned selection. Counterevidence already exists: without counts, baseline-pooled AUC .6102261 is below baseline-din .6133620. This is a new local controlled question about familiar mechanisms; no global architectural novelty is asserted.

nearest_work.difference: DIN discusses average/sum pooling, target-adaptive local activation and avoiding softmax to preserve intensity. Local reference uses normalized softmax and substituted category/brand/action/age fields. We retain explicit bounded count slots while replacing only the weighting query or the weighting operation. Neither pooling nor intensity preservation is claimed as new; no exact DIN reproduction.

inherited_components: Frozen protocol, static benchmark attributes with undocumented as-of dates, causal supplied prefix, category/brand bucket semantics and missing-ID rules.
Parent additive 16-dimensional category, brand, action and logarithmic recency embeddings; shared static/history category and brand tables.
Parent scoring network Linear(4d,64), PReLU, Linear(64,1); all tensors created in original order, including dormant tensors.
Parent output MLP [128,64], static concatenation, a single d-dimensional history summary, and four normalized log-count channels.
N-only zero-slot control from g1-r0003-attention_activity; standard host optimizer, loss, labels and checkpointing.
study.proposed_difference: Four standalone modules implement a 3-by-2 design with two existing target-aware controls. mean_match and mean_activity compute mask/N and never execute the scorer; trainable history values remain. content_match and content_activity execute the unchanged scorer on [0,h,-h,0], removing target conditioning from weights while keeping learned content selection. Prediction remains target dependent through static inputs, match slots when enabled, and the final MLP. We do not claim a target-independent predictor or equal active capacity. Earlier behavior slots (.611913 versus interleaved .613042) and separate field values (.613185 versus collapsed .613311) did not justify finer learned partitions; count versus rate helped (~.00237 AUC), observed versus independent joint did not (~.000004). Retain those unsuccessful directions and the failed total-removal hypothesis instead of restarting a tokenization claim. The new difference is conditional replacement and the factorial contrast, not an invention of mean pooling.
predictions: Primary screening prediction: content_match is within .0003 absolute AUC of g1-r0002-joint_count and worsens Logloss by no more than .0001, while remaining above count-only g1-r0003-count_summary. Mean_match tests the stronger simplification with the same quality thresholds.

Partial-substitution prediction: (AUC_attention_activity - AUC_replacement_activity) minus (AUC_attention_match - AUC_replacement_match) is at least .0003 for each replacement; report the actual difference even if negative. This is a screening criterion, not a significance threshold.
If generic learned event importance is necessary, content_match exceeds mean_match by more than .0003 AUC; if not, mean pooling is sufficient within this implementation and protocol.

A cost-preserving mean candidate must reduce measured allocated GPU or train seconds by at least 5% at matched three passes while meeting both quality tolerances; wall time, peak memory, throughput and p50/p95 are reported separately. No content-mode speed claim is assumed.

Label-free first-512 diagnostics: mean/content summaries and weights stay invariant under within-field target rotation with histories fixed (RMS/L1 deltas <=1e-6), including empty histories. Mean nonempty effective event count equals N within numerical tolerance. These verify implementation, not predictive sufficiency.

Frozen host slice bins are exploratory: report counts, positives and negatives for all returned slices; inspect match-present/absent and history-length strata without selecting a winner on a slice. Small/single-class slices are insufficient, not evidence of no effect.
falsifiers: If both replacements lose more than .0003 AUC or .0001 Logloss against g1-r0002-joint_count, the proposed cheap-sufficiency prediction fails for these implementations. An AUC increase with a Logloss penalty is a tradeoff, not unconditional improvement.
If target-aware advantage does not shrink in the match condition relative to activity-only, explicit match counts have not substituted for target-dependent weighting as predicted.

If content-only weights do not outperform mean at useful quality/cost, learned generic event weighting is unsupported. If mean exceeds tolerances despite skipping the scorer, retire the learned-weighting necessity explanation locally.

Nonzero target-rotation summary dependence in mean/content mode, nonfinite outputs/diagnostics, shape errors, or broken masking invalidate an execution; retain charged failure receipts and repair before interpretation.

No >=5% measured training/GPU saving invalidates an efficiency claim even if prediction quality is retained. Unmeasured equal-compute quality and single-seed outcomes do not establish a frontier or repeated support.
alternative_explanations: The joint model may require a genuinely target-specific distributed history signal beyond exact bucket matches; the original pooling baseline and complete-removal failure support this competing explanation.

Removing the target query reduces effective input rank; changing event weights changes norm, gradient routing and conditioning. Allocated-parameter equality does not resolve these explanations. First-512 summary norms and concentration are only diagnostics.

Seed noise, checkpoint selection on reused validation and earlier branch selection may inflate small differences. All current comparisons are preliminary at seed 42; paired 42/43/44 validation repetitions and user-cluster intervals only if the host exposes authorized predictions are needed.

85.2% at the history limit in the earlier first-512 diagnostic is not a population estimate. Truncation, hash collisions and coarse vocabulary can make generic summaries appear sufficient; conclusions apply only to supplied prefixes, not full raw histories.
The static snapshot timing assumption remains unverified. This is benchmark modeling evidence rather than verified production point-in-time utility.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: baseline-din wall 610.8195 s; baseline-pooled 578.9037 s; g1-r0002-joint_count 587.1395 s; g1-r0003-attention_activity 599.0447 s. Runtime full-unit estimate 704.3729729604 s, cap 1760.9324324011 s; remaining 76569.6625 s at resolution. Four proposed trials: ~2817.49 s at estimate, <=7043.73 s at cap. All preparation and host diagnostics charged; no training/calibration/installations in coding jail.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve four additional full trial caps (~7043.73 s) for discriminating scale/effective-capacity replacements or a repaired promising branch, including failures. This is a reserve only, not authorization to execute unregistered variants. Current four cells are all counted; existing attention controls already paid. Stop speculation and reassess on receipts.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve nine full trial caps (~15848.39 s) for one frozen final candidate plus the incumbent and the closest replacement control at paired seeds 42/43/44. Conservatively includes seed-42 reruns; accepted matching-hash receipts may be reused by host. Freeze exact source/config/checkpoint hashes, comparisons and commands before final validation assessment. No test feedback or closed archive is authorized.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Current suite plus attribution plus assessment reserves total ~29935.85 s at trial caps, below the resolved remaining budget before continued charged preparation. Admit follow-ups only when the refreshed ledger covers a complete unit plus reserves; never raise limits. Stop on hard cap, integrity failure, user stop or no admissible discriminating unit. This phase ends after proposal/source checks; host trains automatically. Do not wait for or launch training locally.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Reviewed the prior declared use against local removal outcomes and primary tiny-mode section 5.3. Source-motivated total attention removal did not preserve local quality (.617127 to .613095). That failed transfer motivates a narrower replacement retaining learned event values; it does not refute the source system.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Replace target-conditioned attention by mean or content-only weighted learned values alongside inherited direct match counts, crossed with N-only controls.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No FM Highway, per-layer dots, buses, delay labels, source split or optimizer. Retains a shallow single summary; no global novelty or source-system reproduction.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If replacements do not retain quality at measured benefit, local attention simplification remains unsupported. More source citation cannot override the negative result.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary section 5.2 Table 4 reports query-related ablation losses in another setting. Use as competing evidence and a reason to test query necessity before expanding queries, not as evidence it transfers.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Zero only the query input to the existing event scorer, crossed with explicit target-match counts and activity-only slots. Mean variants distinguish query removal from learned weighting removal.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No generated probes, field bridge, packed multi-view execution or source training. Reduced active input rank remains a confound despite identical allocated scorer parameters.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If content-only loses materially to target-aware weighting even with explicit matches, query-free sufficiency fails locally. This does not validate QueryFormer query generation.
